<!-- GitHub Pages serves docs/404.html for any missing page. The log below reads like
     Stata's Results window; the script fills in the path the visitor asked for. -->

```{=html}
<div class="stata-log" role="group" aria-label="Stata output: the page was not found"><span>. use "<span class="nf-path">/this-page</span>", clear</span>
<span class="stata-err">file <span class="nf-path">/this-page</span>.dta not found</span>
<span class="stata-err">r(601);</span>

<span class="stata-note">. * Probably a moved page or a typo in the link. Try one of these:</span>

<a href="/">. view browse "/"</a>            <span class="stata-note">// home</span>
<a href="/research/">. view browse "/research"</a>    <span class="stata-note">// papers</span>
<a href="/teaching/">. view browse "/teaching"</a>    <span class="stata-note">// courses</span>
<a href="/cv/">. view browse "/cv"</a>
<a href="/blog/">. view browse "/blog"</a>

<span class="stata-note">. * Or type a command below. Start with: help</span>
<div class="stata-out" aria-live="polite"></div><form class="stata-prompt" autocomplete="off"><label for="stata-cmd">.</label> <input id="stata-cmd" type="text" spellcheck="false" autocapitalize="off" enterkeyhint="go" aria-label="Stata command"></form></div>
<script>
// A small Stata prompt. Everything typed is shown with textContent, never as HTML.
(() => {
  let p = location.pathname;
  try { p = decodeURI(p); } catch (e) {}
  p = p.replace(/(\/index)?\.html$/, '').replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/';
  document.querySelectorAll('.nf-path').forEach(el => { el.textContent = p; });

  const out = document.querySelector('.stata-out');
  const form = document.querySelector('.stata-prompt');
  const input = document.getElementById('stata-cmd');
  if (!out || !form || !input) return;
  const add = (text, cls, href) => {
    const el = document.createElement(href ? 'a' : 'span');
    el.textContent = text;
    if (cls) el.className = cls;
    if (href) el.href = href;
    out.append(el, '\n');
  };
  const err = (msg, code) => { add(msg, 'stata-err'); add(`r(${code});`, 'stata-err'); };
  const go = (path, label) => { add(label || `(opening ${path})`, 'stata-note'); setTimeout(() => { location.href = path; }, 500); };
  const reg = [
    '',
    'Linear regression                               Number of obs     =      1,461',
    '                                                (nights since the Ph.D. began)',
    '',
    '------------------------------------------------------------------------------',
    '       sleep | Coefficient  Std. err.      t    P>|t|     [95% conf. interval]',
    '-------------+----------------------------------------------------------------',
    '         phd |  -2.713044   .0857661   -31.63   0.000    -2.881282   -2.544806',
    '       _cons |   7.902114   .1203348    65.67   0.000     7.666066    8.138162',
    '------------------------------------------------------------------------------',
  ];
  const help = [
    'Things to try:',
    '  help rrmaximiliano     who wrote this site',
    '  sysuse cv              open the CV',
    '  reg sleep phd          a well-identified result',
    '  view browse "/"        go to a page (also: cd research, cd ~)',
    '  di 2+2                 display',
    '  cls                    clear the screen',
  ];
  const run = raw => {
    const cmd = raw.trim();
    const [verb = '', ...rest] = cmd.split(/\s+/);
    const args = rest.join(' ');
    const v = verb.toLowerCase();
    if (!cmd) return;
    if (v === 'cls') { out.textContent = ''; return; }
    if (v === 'clear') return;
    if (v === 'help' || v === 'h') {
      if (/^rrmaximiliano$/i.test(args)) {
        add('rrmaximiliano -- Rony Rodríguez-Ramírez');
        add('    Ph.D. candidate in Education Policy and Program Evaluation');
        add('    at Harvard University.');
        add('    Studies how education can protect and rebuild children\'s human capital');
        add('    after armed conflict, forced displacement, and political crises.');
        add('    From Nicaragua.');
        add('    See also: view browse "/research"', '', '/research/');
        return;
      }
      if (args) { err(`help for ${args} not found`, 111); return; }
      help.forEach(l => add(l));
      return;
    }
    if (v === 'sysuse' || v === 'use') {
      if (/^"?cv"?(,\s*clear)?$/i.test(args)) { add('(Rony Rodríguez-Ramírez, curriculum vitae)'); go('/cv/'); return; }
      const f = args.replace(/,.*$/, '').replace(/"/g, '').trim() || 'nothing';
      err(`file ${f}${/\.dta$/i.test(f) ? '' : '.dta'} not found`, 601);
      return;
    }
    if (/^reg(r(e(ss?)?)?)?$/.test(v)) {
      if (/^sleep\s+phd\b/i.test(args)) { reg.forEach(l => add(l)); return; }
      const missing = args.split(/[\s,]+/).find(x => x && !/^(sleep|phd)$/i.test(x)) || 'varlist';
      err(`variable ${missing} not found`, 111);
      return;
    }
    if (v === 'ssc' || v === 'net') { add('nice try. this is a website.', 'stata-note'); return; }
    if (v === 'pikachu') {
      err('command pikachu is unrecognized', 199);
      add('. * it is a real command, though. read about it here', 'stata-note', '/go/useless/');
      return;
    }
    if (v === 'exit' || v === 'q' || v === 'quit') {
      if (/clear/i.test(args)) { go('/'); return; }
      err('no; dataset in memory has changed since last saved', 4);
      return;
    }
    if (v === 'di' || v === 'dis' || v === 'disp' || v === 'display') {
      const q = args.match(/^"(.*)"$/);
      if (q) { add(q[1]); return; }
      if (/^[\d\s+\-*/().]+$/.test(args)) {
        try { const n = Function(`"use strict"; return (${args})`)(); if (Number.isFinite(n)) { add(String(n)); return; } } catch (e) {}
      }
      err('invalid syntax', 198);
      return;
    }
    if (v === 'cd' || (v === 'view' && /^browse\b/i.test(args))) {
      let path = (v === 'cd' ? args : args.replace(/^browse\s*/i, '')).replace(/"/g, '').trim();
      if (!path || path === '~' || path === '/') { go('/'); return; }
      if (/^[a-z]+:/i.test(path) || path.startsWith('//')) { add('only pages on this site, sorry.', 'stata-note'); return; }
      if (!path.startsWith('/')) path = '/' + path;
      if (!/^\/[\w\-./]*$/.test(path)) { err('invalid syntax', 198); return; }
      go(path.endsWith('/') || /\.\w+$/.test(path) ? path : path + '/');
      return;
    }
    err(`command ${verb} is unrecognized`, 199);
  };
  const history = [];
  let at = 0;
  form.addEventListener('submit', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cmd = input.value;
    add(`. ${cmd}`);
    if (cmd.trim()) { history.push(cmd); at = history.length; }
    input.value = '';
    run(cmd);
    input.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  });
  input.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key !== 'ArrowUp' && e.key !== 'ArrowDown') return;
    e.preventDefault();
    at = Math.max(0, Math.min(history.length, at + (e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : 1)));
    input.value = history[at] ?? '';
  });
  // Ready to type on computers; phones would pop the keyboard open, so not there
  if (matchMedia('(pointer: fine)').matches) input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
})();
</script>
```
